title: Conditional Aggregation in Context-Aware Fuzzy Systems: A Fibered Representation Theory
summary: Conditional aggregation operators evaluate profiles relative to admissible contexts whose active sources, criteria, or rules may vary. For a fixed context, such an operator is indeed an ordinary monotone functional on the restricted profile. The nontrivial structure appears at the family level, where local functionals on different profile spaces must be compared and possibly represented by one global rule.
